_doc: Columns that src/ writes but nothing reads (deadWritten) and columns nothing references at all (neverReferenced), measured on IDevelop's schema after migration 189. The list may only shrink: a new entry needs a review and a reason.

columns.reason: privacy record: the legal hold as it stood when the override was requested, kept as evidence and never displayed
privacy record: when an approved override was executed; evidence for an audit, not shown
audit stamp: who validated the plan; the plan pages show the state, not the actor
audit stamp: who excluded the participant; the campaign console shows the category, not the actor
audit stamp: who assigned the reviewer
calibration stamp, kept for the record
freshness stamp written by the coverage check; a reader is wanted on the coverage page
freshness stamp of the 30-60-90 day projection; a reader is wanted on the coverage page
audit stamp: who cancelled the campaign (maintenance panel); the system log names the actor too
audit stamp: who forced a reopening
audit stamp of a 360° report release (manager, or the round closing); the report shows that it was released, not by whom
audit stamp of a 360° report release, paired with released_by_type
privacy record: who resolved a paused trigger
SSO migration record: who handed the invitation over by hand
lineage of a carried-forward objective, kept until a history view exists
LMS catalogue sync stamp; the LMS hub shows the completion sync only
task record: who resolved the task
task record: the plan or placement a task was resolved into
audit stamp: who changed the posting's state
9-box record: who submitted the placement; the console shows the state, not the actor
9-box record: who rejected the placement
9-box record: when the placement was rejected
outbound webhook log (telemetry, pruned): the subscription a delivery went to, kept for troubleshooting in the database
enrolment stamp filled by its column default, never shown
data-subject request register stamp, not written or read by the current flow
LMS ingestion stamp filled by its column default, never displayed
replay protection: the row's existence is the check; the purge reads expires_at
early column with no writer and no reader; candidate for removal
the TOTP period is fixed at 30 s in code and never read back from the row
